    • Constructor Detail

      • LowlandModalityDetector

        public LowlandModalityDetector​(double sensitivity,
                               double precision,
                               boolean diagnostics)
        Constructs a LowlandModalityDetector with specified sensitivity and precision parameters. The detector uses a "lowland" algorithm which imagines that the histogram is a mountain relief (side view) and after "raining" it identifies modes. For more details, we recommend reading original article from Andrey Akinshin: A. Akinshin "Lowland Multimodality Detection"
        Parameters:
        sensitivity - higher sensitivity allows you to detect small, almost hidden, modes, but increases the chance of false positive detections. On the other hand, with low sensitivity small or medium modes may be missed.
        precision - histogram bin resolution where lower values provide finer resolution but may overfit to noise
        diagnostics - enables collection of diagnostic information for analyzing density histograms

      • analyzePeaks

        private ModalityData analyzePeaks​(List<Integer> peaks,
                                  List<DensityHistogramBin> bins,
                                  List<Double> binHeights,
                                  DensityHistogram histogram,
                                  DiagnosticsBin[] diagnosticsBins,
                                  WeightedSample sample)
        Analyzes detected peaks to find significant modes and cut points between them. Implements a peak merging algorithm where adjacent peaks are compared to determine if they represent distinct modes based on sensitivity.
        Parameters:
        peaks - list of peak indices from the histogram
        bins - list of histogram bins
        binHeights - list of bin heights
        histogram - the density histogram
        diagnosticsBins - array for diagnostic information if enabled
        sample - original weighted sample
        Returns:
        ModalityData with detected modes and their characteristics

      • trySplit

        private boolean trySplit​(int peak0,
                         int peak1,
                         int peak2,
                         List<DensityHistogramBin> bins,
                         List<Double> binHeights,
                         List<Double> modeLocations,
                         List<Double> cutPoints,
                         DiagnosticsBin[] diagnosticsBins)
        Attempts to split the region between three peaks to identify distinct modes. Calculates the "lowland" area between peaks and compares it to sensitivity threshold to determine if peaks represent separate modes.
        Parameters:
        peak0 - first peak index in the candidate sequence
        peak1 - middle peak index being evaluated
        peak2 - third peak index in the candidate sequence
        bins - list of histogram bins
        binHeights - list of bin heights
        modeLocations - list to add confirmed mode locations
        cutPoints - list to add cut points between modes
        diagnosticsBins - array for diagnostic markings
        Returns:
        true if successful split occurred and modes were added, false otherwise

      • createModalityData

        private ModalityData createModalityData​(List<Double> modeLocations,
                                        List<Double> cutPoints,
                                        List<DensityHistogramBin> bins,
                                        List<Double> binHeights,
                                        DensityHistogram histogram,
                                        WeightedSample sample,
                                        DiagnosticsBin[] diagnosticsBins)
        Creates the final ModalityData object from detected modes and cut points. Constructs RangedMode objects for each detected mode with their boundaries and sample data.
        Parameters:
        modeLocations - list of detected mode locations
        cutPoints - list of cut points between modes
        bins - list of histogram bins
        binHeights - list of bin heights
        histogram - the density histogram
        sample - original weighted sample
        diagnosticsBins - diagnostic information if enabled
        Returns:
        ModalityData containing all detected modes and histogram information

      • localMode

        private RangedMode localMode​(double modeLocation,
                             double lower,
                             double upper,
                             WeightedSample sample,
                             List<DensityHistogramBin> bins)
        Creates a local mode within specified boundaries. Extracts sample data within the mode boundaries and creates a weighted sample representing the local mode distribution.
        Parameters:
        modeLocation - the central location of the mode
        lower - lower boundary of the mode
        upper - upper boundary of the mode
        sample - original weighted sample
        bins - list of histogram bins
        Returns:
        RangedMode representing the local mode with its boundaries and sample data
        Throws:
        IllegalStateException - if no values are found within the specified boundaries
